changelog: The cohorts table and the candidate page's deadline line read the tenant's own stages (#1884, slice 2). `/admin/cohorts` counted "hired" as `['HIRED_660','EMPLOYED_700']`, which is 0 on a renamed pipeline. It now uses `outcomeStageKeysFrom(useResolvedStages()).finished` (the #1882 rule). The "⚠ Overdue — past the stage deadline" line on `/admin/candidates/[id]` now uses the one stage-clock rule, `isStageOverdue(…, stages)` (#1724), instead of an inline key list, so a placed candidate on a custom terminal stage is no longer flagged. On the default catalogue this also stops flagging dropped / found-elsewhere relations, which the board chip already treated as stopped. `outcomeStageKeysFrom` moved into the client-safe `src/lib/pipeline.ts` and is re-exported from `pipelineStages.ts`. Two more files leave the `check:stage-keys` baseline. Covered by `e2e/custom-pipeline-terminal-client.spec.ts`.

en: On a customised pipeline, the cohorts page now counts hires correctly, and a placed candidate is no longer shown as past their stage deadline.
tr: Özelleştirilmiş aşamalarda kohort sayfası işe yerleşenleri artık doğru sayıyor; yerleşmiş bir aday aşama süresi geçmiş olarak gösterilmiyor.
de: Bei einer angepassten Pipeline zählt die Kohortenseite Einstellungen jetzt korrekt, und eine vermittelte Person wird nicht mehr als über der Phasenfrist angezeigt.
